input.summary:
Implemented a complete Task Management API with the following files:

**Core Infrastructure:**
- `src/types.ts` — All shared TypeScript interfaces and types (User, Project, Task, Comment, Notification, event payloads)
- `src/event-bus.ts` — In-memory pub/sub singleton with `publish(event, payload)` and `subscribe(event, callback)` methods; subscriber errors are isolated so they cannot break publishers

**Services (each owns its own in-memory Map store):**
- `src/services/user-service.ts` — CRUD for users
- `src/services/project-service.ts` — CRUD for projects + `addMember`/`removeMember` (idempotent add)
- `src/services/task-service.ts` — CRUD for tasks + `changeStatus` (enforces forward-only `todo→in-progress→done` via a transition table) + `assignTask`; publishes `task.statusChanged` and `task.assigned` events to the bus
- `src/services/comment-service.ts` — CRUD for comments; publishes `comment.added` events; accepts pre-resolved `taskTitle`/`authorName` from the router to avoid cross-service calls
- `src/services/notification-service.ts` — Subscribes to all three event types at construction time and creates in-memory notifications; exposes `listForUser` and `markRead`

**HTTP Layer:**
- `src/router.ts` — Single HTTP entry point; pattern-matches on path segments and method; the only place that performs cross-service data lookups (e.g. resolving task title + author name before creating a comment); uses a `sendNoContent` helper to avoid returning `ServerResponse` from `void` functions
- `src/main.ts` — Boots the HTTP server on PORT (default 3000)

**Demo:**
- `src/demo.ts` — Self-contained demo that spins up the server on a random port and runs 71 assertions covering every endpoint, every error case, forward-only status transition enforcement, idempotent member adds, event-driven notification counts, and mark-as-read. All 71 pass.
